Our LCD & Display collection features a variety of high-quality display solutions including TFT, OLED, and e-paper screens. From small OLED displays to large capacitive touchscreens, these products are ideal for enhancing your projects with vibrant visuals and interactive functionality. Compatible with major microcontroller platforms such as Raspberry Pi and Arduino, these displays offer diverse uses ranging from educational tools to advanced IoT applications. Equip your next project with the perfect display to achieve outstanding visual performance.

Discover a wide assortment of high-quality robot parts designed to enhance and elevate your projects. Whether you're building from scratch or upgrading existing designs, our parts are engineered to deliver exceptional performance and reliability. Dive into our extensive selection and find exactly what you need to bring your robotics vision to life.

Description Waveshare 10.3" e-Paper E-Ink Display HAT for Raspberry Pi, 1872×1404, Black/White, 16 Grey Scales, USB/SPI/I80 Offers high 1872x1404 resolution for clear text and images Achieves paper-like display with microcapsule electrophoretic technology Supports 16 grey scales for enhanced image depth Ensures ultra-low power consumption, ideal for efficiency Includes USB/SPI/I80 interfaces for versatile connectivity The Waveshare 10.3" e-Paper E-Ink Display HAT for Raspberry Pi, 1872×1404, Black/White, 16 Grey Scales, USB/SPI/I80 is an advanced display module designed for integration with Raspberry Pi systems. This e-Paper display offers a high resolution of 1872×1404 pixels, providing clear and sharp text and images in black and white. It supports a wide range of grey scales, from 2 to 16, enhancing the depth and detail of displayed content. This display is characterized by its paper-like appearance, achieved through microcapsule electrophoretic technology, which reflects ambient light to produce a natural reading experience similar to traditional paper. The display does not require a backlight, allowing it to maintain the last displayed content even when powered down, thus conserving energy. Its ultra-low power consumption makes it ideal for applications where power efficiency is crucial. The display supports partial refresh, which is beneficial for applications requiring frequent updates without the need for a full screen refresh. It features a wide viewing angle of over 170 degrees, ensuring visibility from various positions. The communication interface includes USB, SPI, and I80, providing flexibility in connecting with different controller boards, such as Raspberry Pi and STM32. The module includes a standard Raspberry Pi 40PIN GPIO extension header, ensuring compatibility with the Raspberry Pi series boards. It comes with development resources and a manual, offering examples for Raspberry Pi and STM32, facilitating ease of integration and development. Note: Ensure the display is used in environments with sufficient ambient light, as it is passively reflective and requires external light sources for optimal visibility.
